text:
maria: Hey folks — PR #12012 is ready for review: dynamic kernel selection for short prefixes + eviction-header tweak. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/12012. This is targeted for a canary rollout; it touches runtime kernel selection logic and an HTTP eviction header surface. Tagging @sasha (runtime), @kevin (platform), @jordan (eng-infra), @tanvi (security). Need approvals + a short rollout plan. Trying to merge by tomorrow AM if we get sign-offs.
sasha: Quick Q — any ABI changes or model format diffs? also can you paste perf numbers for seq lengths 128/512/1024?
maria: No ABI or model format changes, just selection logic. Perf highlights from perf harness (baseline vs this PR): seq=128 median token latency -0.8ms; seq=512 throughput +6%; seq=1024 negligible diff. Added the raw perf run output to the PR (+ unit tests).
jordan: Infra notes: operator changes look fine but please gate behind a feature flag. Recommend rollout: feature.runtime.dynamic_kernel_v2 = off by default, enable 10% canary, then 50%, then 100%. Also confirm eviction header name won't collide with existing proxies.
kevin: Platform asks: can we pick a 2-hour low-traffic window for the canary? Also add the following metrics to the rollout dashboard: kernel_select.latency, runtime.cache.hit_rate, runtime.eviction.count, and a health check that ensures no increase in 5xxs.
tanvi: From security: please attach a short threat model and dataflow notes in the PR. Does eviction header ever include user payloads or PII? Any new secrets or KMS changes? We need those details before security sign-off.
maria: Answering: eviction header only carries cache-key fingerprint (sha256 hex), no user PII. No KMS or secret changes. I've added a 1-paragraph threat model and dataflow diagram link in the PR description.
sasha: Looks good. One more ask: add a rollback script stub and CI perf assertion (regression <2% on core perf suite) so we don't land regressions silently. After that I can approve.
maria: Added rollback script snippet to ops/deploy/rollback_dynamic_kernel.sh and a CI perf check in .github/workflows/perf.yml. Scheduling canary for tomorrow 03:00-05:00 PST (low traffic). @sasha please approve when you can; @kevin FYI for dashboard wiring.
sasha: Approved. :rocket:
kevin: LGTM from platform side, will wire metrics to the canary dashboard.
deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled for 1960212400 (tomorrow 03:00 PST) — will report back on metrics.
